title: Rav Nachman bar Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rav in Shabbat 25b. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Chanin bar Rava. Hyman identifies him, without doubt, as the one mentioned in Avodah Zarah 39a as Rav Nachman bar Abba, reporting Rav: “This is sultanit.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source prints נוכר where the mention formula suggests נזכר. Its Hebrew is retained. The confident identification and the different patronymics are Hyman’s; sultanit is left as the named fish.

The checked Shabbat 25b passage gives Rav Nachman bar Rava as an alternative to Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda; Avodah Zarah 39a names Rav Nachman bar Abba reporting Rav about sultanit. Hyman’s “without doubt” identification across these patronymics remains his categorical claim. His reported Dikdukei Soferim variant has not been directly collated, and the printed נוכר is preserved in the Hebrew.
